hero.eyebrow: no app · no signup · free forever
hero.subtitle: Trips, dinners, flatmates. Share one link — everyone adds what they paid, and we work out who owes who.
hero.ctaHint: Takes ten seconds. No email, no password, no download.

rooms.title: Your rooms
rooms.subtitle: Saved on this device.
rooms.more: and {count, plural, one {# more} other {# more}}

step1.title: Start a split
step1.body: Name it, pick an emoji and a currency. Ski trip, flat bills, Tuesday dinner.

step2.title: Share the link
step2.body: Drop it in the group chat. Nobody installs anything or makes an account.

step3.title: Everyone adds expenses
step3.body: Balances update live, and the maths reconciles to the cent — on screen, every time.

item1.title: Free forever
item1.body: No fees, no premium tier, nothing to upgrade to.

item2.title: No account needed
item2.body: No email, no password, no ID checks. The link is the key — keep it in the group.

item3.title: Settle however you like
item3.body: Cash, bank transfer, or whatever app you already use. We just record it.

install.title: Add Split to your home screen
install.body: Opens instantly, works like an app. No store, no account.

ios.title: Add Split to your home screen
ios.body: Two taps in Safari and Split lives on your home screen like an app.
ios.step1: Tap the Share button in the Safari toolbar.
ios.step2: Scroll down and choose “Add to Home Screen”.

header.soundHint: Little ticks, thunks and a bell
header.privacyNote: Free forever, no signup. Room links are unlisted — only people you send it to can open it.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.emptyBody: Add the first one — who paid, how much, and who it was for.

states.errorTitle: We could not load this room
states.errorBody: Probably a wobbly connection. Nothing is lost — try again.
states.notFoundBody: Room links are case-sensitive — check you copied the whole thing, including the bit after the last dash.

allSettled.title: All settled up
allSettled.body: Nobody owes anybody anything. Enjoy the rare feeling.

validation.DESCRIPTION_REQUIRED: Give it a name so everyone remembers what it was.
validation.AMOUNT_REQUIRED: Enter an amount greater than zero.
validation.NO_PARTICIPANTS: Pick at least one person to split this between.
validation.SHARES_DO_NOT_ADD_UP: The exact amounts have to add up to the total.

settle.nothingToSettle: Nothing to settle yet — add an expense first.
settle.intro: The fewest payments that clear everything. Pay however you like — we just record it.
settle.peanutNote: Opens peanut.me in a new tab to send it — and records the payment here either way.
settle.failed: could not record that payment — try again

share.title: Invite the rest
share.subtitle: One link. They tap it, pick their name, and they are in.

account.title: Your rooms on any device
account.blurb: Save your rooms — enter your email and access them from any device. No password, nothing to sign up for.
account.sentBody: If that address can receive mail, a link to your rooms is on its way. Open it on whichever device you want them on.
account.signedInHint: Open that link on any device and these rooms follow you there.
account.failed: could not send the link — try again
account.newPhone: Using a new phone someday? Save your rooms

push.title: Notifications
push.notifyHint: When someone adds an expense or settles up.
push.on: You’ll get notifications for this room
push.iosNeedsPwa: Add Split to your home screen to get notifications.
push.denied: Notifications are blocked for this site in your browser settings.
push.needsToken: Turning these on needs proof it is really you — rejoin the room with your own name first.
push.failed: could not change notifications — try again

errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Could not reach the server — check your connection.
errors.INTERNAL: Something went wrong on our side. Try again in a moment.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: That does not look right — check the fields and try again.
errors.MALFORMED_JSON: Something went wrong sending that — try again.
errors.EXPENSE_NOT_FOUND: That expense is no longer here — refresh the room.
errors.SETTLEMENT_NOT_FOUND: That payment is no longer here — refresh the room.
errors.SLUG_EXHAUSTED: Could not create a room link just now — try again.
errors.DUPLICATE_MEMBER_NAME: That name is already in this room — pick it from the list instead.
errors.EXPENSE_DELETED: This expense was deleted. Undo the delete first, then edit it.
errors.NOT_A_MEMBER: That person is not in this room — refresh and try again.
errors.AMOUNT_NOT_POSITIVE: The amount has to be greater than zero.
errors.EXACT_SHARES_REQUIRED: An exact split needs an amount for each person.
errors.SHARES_DO_NOT_ADD_UP: The exact amounts have to add up to the total.
errors.NO_PARTICIPANTS: Pick at least one person to split this between.
errors.DUPLICATE_PARTICIPANT: Someone appears twice in this split.
errors.SETTLEMENT_PAYER_NOT_MEMBER: Whoever paid is not in this room — refresh and try again.
errors.SETTLEMENT_PAYEE_NOT_MEMBER: Whoever was paid is not in this room — refresh and try again.
errors.SETTLEMENT_SAME_MEMBER: A payment needs two different people.

derivation.title: How this adds up
derivation.checkNote: Every line comes from this room. Add them up yourself — it matches.
derivation.emptyBody: No expenses, no payments — nothing has touched this balance.
derivation.suggestedNote: Suggested payments clear the whole room in the fewest transfers, so who pays whom isn’t always who spent on whom. Both balances are here to check.

offline.rowHint: Queued — sends itself when you’re back online
offline.queuedToast: No connection. This expense is saved on your phone and sends itself when you’re back.
offline.fullToast: {count, plural, one {Too many expenses waiting — the oldest one was dropped.} other {Too many expenses waiting — the # oldest were dropped.}}
offline.rejectedToast: {count, plural, one {A waiting expense could not be saved — add it again.} other {# waiting expenses could not be saved — add them again.}}
offline.sentToast: {count, plural, one {Expense sent} other {# expenses sent}}
